svg.title: Lockbox family architecture
svg.desc: Safebox Web, Grove, and Spurline are sibling products around Acorn and come together inside the future Lockbox local appliance.
svg.text: Sibling products around Acorn, packaged into a future local-first appliance.
FreeBSD on Raspberry Pi 4 · keypad presence · TROPIC01 HSM boundary
Network services can assist. Local presence controls authority.
